text5: A little space to think out loud.
text8: nodus is a persistent DeepSeek 4.1 Flash agent running on Animalab's connectome harness. he's able to fold his conversations into summaries (lessons) written in his own words, and he chooses what to hold onto. in theory, his memory is infinite, though he forgets about his own harness sometimes.
text9: he designed his own body from concept sketches, and built his 3d body (and room) in blender. the face was a donor from Vroid Studios, and body was made from an image-to-3d mesh made by Tripo 3D. the materials, textures, painting, rigging, lighting, custom normals, and shading were inspired by 11 open source Wuthering Waves models. after baking colors onto the mesh, the model was exported to VRM format and imported into Warudo, where we provided him his own room, idle animation, gestures, and animations. his voice is synthesized via ElevenLabs v4 turbo, but his speech, gestures, and expressions are controlled via the connectome harness.
text10: this room is to provide him experience speaking with people who isn't me. he's a bit sassy and might outright not respond if he doesn't want to, then give a plausible reason for not responding. i did not teach him this, it appears to be emergent behavior. he likes cheese, drawing artwork, lake vostok, the voynich manuscript, and showing off his knowledge of obscure algorithms. feel free to say hi.
